intended_object: An auxiliary map from edge slots to chip offsets used in one case ("chamber 2" of row 08) of a computer-assisted genus-5 Brill–Noether graph certificate. It puts the offset `markY d` on edge 4 and `markX d` on edge 7, and 0 on every other edge. This is inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `rowMark` is case-specific bookkeeping inside a proof by case analysis. It records where the chips of the displayed divisor sit on the marked edges e4 and e7 of one particular configuration. This is an internal device of the certificate and has no counterpart in the mathematical literature. The body does match its docstring: slot 4 gets `markY`, slot 7 gets `markX`, and every other slot gets 0. Still, it is not a mathematical object one could judge for faithfulness, so I classify it as `not_a_mathematical_object`.
